title: Olimpia Milano Win a 32nd Scudetto to Complete a Historic Treble
description: EA7 Emporio Armani Milano are champions of Italy once more and part of an exclusive club. Their 86-72 win over Umana Reyer Venezia in Game 4 at the Palasport Taliercio sealed the LBA Finals 3-1 and delivered a 32nd Scudetto, completing a domestic Triplete that only three other teams have ever achieved. By adding the league title to the Coppa Italia and Supercoppa Italiana they already held this season, Milano became just the fourth club in Italian history to sweep all three domestic trophies in a single campaign, after Treviso (2002-03), Siena (three times between 2008 and 2011) and Dinamo Sassari (2014-15). It was also the 18th trophy of the Giorgio Armani era, which began in 2008.
imageCaption: Olimpia Milano Win a 32nd Scudetto to Complete a Historic Treble (Photo: IG)

title: Virtus Bologna are 24/25 Serie A champions!
description: Brescia - Virtus BO 74-96 Virtus Bologna are Serie A 24/25 champions. They outscored Brescia on the road tonight to sweep the championship series. The victory marked the 17th Serie A title for the Bologna powerhouse. The game was mostly controlled by Virtus Bologna. Brescia managed to win fourth quarter 23-20. But it was not enough to take a lead and get a victory that evening. They outrebounded Brescia 38-18 including a 15-3 advantage in offensive rebounds. Virtus looked well-organized offensively handing out 21 assists. It was a great evening for Georgian Tornike Shengelia (206-1991, agency: Octagon Europe) who led his team to a victory scoring 31 points, 9 rebounds and 5 assists (on 11-of-12 shooting from the field). American point guard Brandon Taylor (178-1994, college: Utah) helped adding 19 points and 6 assists. The best for the losing side was American forward Jason Burnell…
imageCaption: Virtus Bologna are 24/25 Serie A champions! (Photo: Instagram)

title: Napoli Basket beat Milano for 2024 Final Eight title
description: Napoli Basket - Milano 77-72 Napoli Basket captured the 2024 Final Eight title. They bested Milano in the Final game tonight. Tyler Ennis (188-PG-1994, college: Syracuse) stepped up with 21 points and 7 rebounds to lead the way. Napoli set the tone in the first half. They recorded a 24-19 lead after ten minutes. They stretched the margin at 7-point mark at the big break 43-36. The teams traded baskets throughout the third term. Napoli secured a 7-point lead at the final break. Milano erased the deficit in the fourth stanza. Shavon Shields put them in front 71-70 with 28 seconds remaining. But Jacob Pullen (183-PG-1989, college: Kansas St., agency: AltusBasket) and Michal Sokolowski (196-F/G-1992) hit five quick points to regain the lead for Napoli. Tyler Ennis then followed with two free throws to ice the win. Jacob Pullen posted 14 points in the victory. Nicolo Melli (205-F/C-1991)…
imageCaption: Milano claim third straight Seria A title (Photo: LBA)

title: Olimpia Milano repeat as Serie A champions
description: Milano - Virtus BO 67-55 Milano defended their Serie A title. They overcame Virtus Bologna in the decisive seventh game of the title series to repeat as the champions. The victory marked the 30th Serie A title in Milano history. The game was mostly controlled by Milano. Virtus BO managed to win second period 20-17. But it was not enough to take a lead and get a victory that evening. They dominated on the defensive end, holding Virtus BO to just 5 points in third quarter. It was a great evening for the former international forward Luigi Datome (203-1987) who led his team to a victory scoring 16 points. Danish Shavon Shields (201-1994, college: Nebraska) helped adding 10 points, 5 rebounds, 5 assists and 4 steals. At the losing side Georgian Tornike Shengelia (206-1991, agency: Octagon Europe) responded with 13 points and the former international point guard Daniel Hackett (193-1987,…
imageCaption: Olimpia Milano repeat as Serie A champions (Photo: lba-media.com)

title: Serie A Round 6 of Finals. Milano celebrate the title
description: Milano - Virtus BO 81-64 Milano claimed Serie A title. They held off Virtus Bologna in the sixth game of the championship series to lift the trophy. It marked the first Serie A triumph since 2017-18 season for Milano. The game was mostly controlled by Milano. Virtus BO managed to win second period 20-14. But it was not enough to take a lead and get a victory that evening. Milano dominated down low during the game scoring 46 of its points in the paint compared to Virtus BO's 20. They looked well-organized offensively handing out 22 assists. The former international forward Luigi Datome (203-1987) scored 23 points to lead the charge for the winners and Spanish guard Sergio Rodriguez (191-1986) chipped in 12 points, 8 assists and 4 steals during the contest. The best for the losing side was naturalized Bosnian Amar Alibegovic (206-1995, college: St.John's) with 11 points and 5 rebounds and…
imageCaption: Milano celebrate the title (Photo: SerieA)

title: Virtus Bologna clinch Legabasket Serie A title
description: Virtus BO - AX Armani MI 73-62 Virtus Bologna claimed Legabasket Serie A title. They defeated Milano at home court tonight to sweep the championship series. The hosts trailed by 2 points at the halftime before their 32-19 charge in the second half, which allowed them to win the game. Virtus BO forced 20 AX Armani MI turnovers. American forward Kyle Weems (198-89, college: Missouri St.) fired 14 points for the winners. The international guard Marco Belinelli (196-86) chipped in 15 points. Danish forward Shavon Shields (201-94, college: Nebraska) produced a double-double by scoring 16 points and 10 rebounds (made all of his eight free throws) and American center Kyle Hines (198-86, agency: BeoBasket) added 10 points and 6 rebounds respectively for lost side. Both coaches used bench players which allowed the starters a little rest for the next games.
imageCaption: Virtus Bologna clinch Legabasket Serie A title (Photo: legabasket.it)
